title: Differentials of a smooth morphism are free near a point, of rank the fibre dimension
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], $x\in X$, $s=f(x)$ with residue field $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field], $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ the fibre of $f$ over $s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and $x'\in X_s$ the point of $X_s$ lying over $x$. Then $d:=\dim_{x'}(X_s)$ [def-kun-dimension] is a non-negative integer, and there are affine open subschemes $V\subseteq S$ and $W\subseteq X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $x\in W$ and $f(W)\subseteq V$ such that, with $R=\mathcal O_S(V)$, $A=\mathcal O_X(W)$ and $R\to A$ the ring map corresponding to $f|_W:W\to V$, the module of Kähler differentials $\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is a free $A$-module of rank $d$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G1 (label lemma-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free, line 7214: for f smooth, Omega_{X/S} is finite locally free with rank_x(Omega_{X/S}) = dim_x(X_{f(x)})), read on an affine open W = Spec A over V = Spec R where Omega_{X/S}|_W is the sheaf of Omega_{A/R} (Lemma 01UT, label lemma-differentials-affine, line 6441) and shrunk to a principal open on which this finite locally free module is free; smoothness in the sense of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] is that of Morphisms Definition 01V5 by more-morphisms.tex Lemma 02H6 (lemma-smooth-formally-smooth)
